verdict.rationale: Elastic's docs offer official skills that teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch, Kibana, Fleet and the wider stack, which is a form of agent-oriented documentation. However, probes found no llms.txt (404) and no markdown docs endpoint (404), so there is no standard machine-readable entry point to point an agent at. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt, markdown or LLM-friendly docs endpoints, detail on what the skills contain and how to install them, and independent hands-on corroboration.
